text:
Leonora Neuffer Bilger received the Francis P. Garvan–John M. Olin Medal in 1953. The [Wikipedia recipient list](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Garvan%E2%80%93Olin_Medal) and a [university archive finding aid](https://findingaids.lib.iastate.edu/spcl/manuscripts/MS678.html) both give that year. I did not verify the team note's claim that she was the 18th recipient, so I'm not relying on it.

CONFIDENCE: 95
